baseline_models.focus_anchor: The purpose clause moves from full payment of plural rewards to a distinct increase sourced in bounty, then grounds both movements in forgiveness and appreciation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse runs a two-channel account. What is owed is completed without deficiency, while bounty is an unowed gift added beyond the balance; forgiveness handles liabilities and appreciation makes received good visible and creditable.

activation_trace.role: Completion without shortfall supplies the exact-settlement phase.
Return for work supplies the owed side of the account.
Addition and growth mark a second movement beyond settlement.
A gift not made obligatory supplies the increase with a gratuitous source.
Covering offense and shielding its bearer from consequence supplies liability release.
Recognition of benefit supplies the positive acknowledgment that answers good action.

changed_reading.before: The verse offers one undifferentiated reward.
changed_reading.after: It stages an exact clearing of what is owed and a separate, noncontractual surplus, with deficit covered and good actively recognized.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reward noun carries a repair branch, while completion, protective covering, growth, gift, and response-to-little all occur in the same focus verse.
baseline_models.mechanism: Payment can be imagined as restoration rather than cash equivalence. A damaged or crookedly healed result is set, covered against harm, brought toward wholeness, and then enlarged beyond what its small input could produce by itself.

activation_trace.role: Setting a broken limb even when it heals crooked supplies a repair image for imperfect work.
A preserving cover shelters the repaired but still vulnerable result.
Wholeness without deficiency gives restoration its intended endpoint.
Growth moves the repaired subject beyond mere return to baseline.
Unrequired giving explains why restoration can exceed strict equivalence.
A little input producing a visible healthy effect supplies the amplification rule.

changed_reading.before: Reward is compensation external to the worker.
changed_reading.after: Reward also repairs and strengthens the imperfect worker or work, covering damage before carrying the result beyond simple restitution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Increase, surplus, protective covering, and the focus adjective's animal and plant response branches form a compact productive system.
baseline_models.mechanism: The final adjective can name a response capacity: slight feed or rain becomes visible fatness or greenness, fullness produces abundant yield, and fresh shoots emerge. Increase from surplus is therefore generative multiplication, not just a larger number entered in a ledger.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency with little feed or rain supplies disproportionate visible response.
Fullness and abundant milk supply a material image of yield exceeding intake.
Fresh shoots emerging supply self-propagating growth rather than static payment.
Growth names the operation performed on the recipients.
Remainder beyond need supplies the productive surplus.
Covering and protection supply the shelter within which fragile growth can persist.

changed_reading.before: Divine appreciation means acknowledging a completed deed.
changed_reading.after: Divine appreciation is also a productive response that makes a small deed visibly grow, fill out, and generate further life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The completion verb includes arrival at an appointment, while the increase root has a packet-supplied secondary mapping to carried provision.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two mapped readings at the same focus word remain live: increase is both added growth and provision carried for transition. Joined to complete arrival and gratuitous giving, the verse can describe being outfitted for, and brought fully to, an appointed destination.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at an appointment and complete attendance supply the destination structure.
Ordinary addition keeps quantitative increase active.
Carried provision for movement supplies the non-dominant transition reading.
Return for work remains the legitimate provision due at the journey's end.
Free giving makes the travel provision exceed earned return.

changed_reading.before: The increase is a bonus deposited after completed labor.
changed_reading.after: The increase may also be provision that carries recipients through a transition into complete arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening use of the same increase root occurs inside creation after varied bodily appendages. This activates a transformative reading of the focus object: bounty may add created capacity to the recipients, not merely add possessions to their account.

activation_trace.role: Growth in the focus remains open to change in the recipient as well as increase in amount.
Free giving supplies the source of the added capacity.
A bodily side or appendage makes the nearby multiplicity embodied rather than merely monetary.
The repeated operation explicitly adds or grows within the created order.
Bringing a created form into being supplies transformation of capacity as the contextual domain.

structural_cues: 35:1 places increase inside creation immediately after counted bodily variation.
In 35:30 the recipients themselves are the direct object of increase, with bounty marked as its source.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one increase root in created bodily variation and again with the recipients as object; I infer an arrow from material augmentation to augmented capacity. A purely quantitative bonus remains fully live.

changed_reading.before: He adds more reward to what they possess.
changed_reading.after: He may enlarge what they are able to be or bear, so bounty can take the form of created capacity in the recipients.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening antithesis of opening, holding, and sending presents mercy as controlled release whose flow no secondary agent can stop or reproduce. The focus increase can therefore be read as an opened outflow from bounty rather than withdrawal from a closed reward treasury.

activation_trace.role: Unobligated giving supplies what is released.
Addition is the effect of the released flow on its recipients.
An enclosure opening into a wider entrance supplies the release gate.
Tender mercy identifies the substance whose availability is opened.
Holding and confinement supply the opposed closed state.
Sending forth supplies the outward motion that no substitute source can initiate.

structural_cues: 35:2 balances opening against holding and sending in two exclusive clauses.
The source phrase in 35:30 marks bounty as origin rather than as an earned quantity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a valve-like contrast around mercy; I transfer that release logic to bounty and treat increase as its effect downstream. The live alternative is the baseline legal account with no flow model.

changed_reading.before: Bounty is a finite bonus taken from a store after wages are calculated.
changed_reading.after: Bounty is an opened, unwithholdable outflow whose arrival itself produces increase.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two rain sequences turn an external input into revived ground, useful growth, ripe fruit, and differentiated color. These scenes make the focus response-to-little branches operational: divine appreciation converts a small received act into living, diverse yield rather than merely multiplying its score.

activation_trace.role: A little feed or rain producing visible health supplies the focus response law.
Growth names the result of that responsive conversion.
Surplus beyond use supplies the excess yield.
Earth becoming alive through rain supplies the basic input-to-life conversion.
Dry pasture revived by rain supplies renewed productivity after apparent exhaustion.
Delivery from above supplies the initiating input in the later scene.
Water conveyed by pouring or irrigation supplies the medium of response.
Bringing something out from concealment supplies the manifestation of latent yield.
Ripe fruit supplies the concrete productive result.
Taking on new color makes the yield differentiated rather than homogeneous.

structural_cues: 35:9 gives the full sequence from atmospheric movement to dead-land revival.
35:27-29 places water, fruit, difference, learned response, recitation, prayer, and spending immediately before the focus purpose clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated rain-to-life mechanisms and focus branches where little input leaves a large visible effect; I infer that deeds function analogically as received seed or rain. A scalar multiplication of reward remains the less material alternative.

changed_reading.before: Small deeds receive a larger counted return.
changed_reading.after: Small deeds are made generative: they emerge as renewed life, differentiated fruit, and further productive capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding frame sends property outward as expenditure yet names the hoped result as trade immune to ruin. Full payment and increase become the return path of a circulation in which giving is not depletion and profit is not exposed to ordinary market decay.

activation_trace.role: Exact completion guarantees that the outgoing value returns without deficiency.
Return for work supplies the settlement side of the commercial mechanism.
Addition supplies profit beyond recovered principal.
Property going out in expenditure supplies the apparent depletion that needs a return path.
The heart's expectation of a hoped result supplies forward-looking investment rather than immediate exchange.
Trade seeking profit explicitly supplies the commercial frame.
Market stagnation ending in spoilage supplies the ordinary failure mode that this trade escapes.

structural_cues: 35:29 immediately precedes the focus and its hoped trade is followed by the focus purpose clause.
The sequence moves from recitation, maintained prayer, and hidden or public spending to settlement and increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expenditure, hoped trade, immunity from decay, and then payment language; I infer that 35:30 cashes out the commercial metaphor as preserved principal plus profit. A judicial wage account remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The verse pays a wage after discrete acts are finished.
changed_reading.after: It completes a nonperishing circulation: what leaves in faithful expenditure returns intact and grows as profit beyond principal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later inheritance scene places selected recipients on a spectrum from self-damaging misplacement through moderation to advance in good, then calls the whole arrangement great bounty. Forgiveness and appreciation can therefore work across unequal states: one covers deficit, the other recognizes and amplifies whatever good is present, while inheritance itself precedes proportional earning.

activation_trace.role: Protection from the consequence of offense supplies a channel for the deficit side of the spectrum.
Recognition of good supplies a channel for positive response at every nonzero level.
Transmission of a book or knowledge as inheritance makes prior bestowal, not purchase, the entry condition.
Selection of a chosen portion supplies inclusion before the three performance classes are named.
Putting something in the wrong place supplies the self-damaging end of the range.
Balance between extremes supplies the middle class.
Advancing in a race supplies the leading class and its excess good.
A nonobligatory gift names the encompassing arrangement after all three classes.

structural_cues: 35:32 places the designation of great bounty after, not before, the three unequal recipient classes.
The inheritance scene follows the focus through 35:31's book-confirmation bridge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inheritance, prior selection, three unequal classes, and an encompassing bounty label; I infer that the focus pair of forgiveness and appreciation mediates that range. The live alternative is that the focus pronoun refers only to the actors of 35:29 and the later classes begin a separate unit.

changed_reading.before: Only fully successful performers receive the focus settlement and bonus in proportion to merit.
changed_reading.after: Bounty can first include and inherit an uneven community, then cover self-damaging deficit and amplify differing degrees of good without flattening the distinctions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The downstream speakers repeat the focus epithets after grief has departed, then identify bounty as being settled in a permanent dwelling untouched by exhausting labor. This turns the provisioned-arrival baseline into an achieved condition: the increase is durable habitation and release from depletion, not portable wealth alone.

activation_trace.role: Complete arrival at an appointment supplies the focus-side transition into the later dwelling.
Departure and passing away supply the removal of the former burden.
Inner roughness from grief identifies what the transition removes.
The repeated forgiveness title retrospectively links protected release from consequence to the achieved state.
The repeated appreciation title links acknowledged good to the speakers' experienced outcome.
Taking up residence supplies arrival as settlement rather than a brief visit.
Belonging to or residing in a dwelling supplies stable habitation.
Remaining in a place supplies permanence.
The repeated gift source identifies habitation itself as the concrete bounty.
Exhausting toil supplies one mode of depletion excluded from the dwelling.
Weakness and fatigue supply the second mode of depletion excluded there.

structural_cues: 35:34 repeats both final focus predicates in the speech of those describing their outcome.
35:35 immediately explains their condition through bounty, permanent residence, and two negated forms of fatigue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact predicate repetition followed by a bounty-caused dwelling without grief or fatigue; I read the later speech as a retrospective realization of the focus promise. It could instead be independent praise after a separately described reward.

changed_reading.before: Bounty provides portable provision or added goods at arrival.
changed_reading.after: Bounty is the arrival and permanent condition itself: settled belonging from which grief, exhaustion, and depletion have departed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later repetitions show the same increase operation feeding opposite trajectories. Concealing benefit compounds abhorrence, commercial loss, and distance, while the focus pairing with appreciation compounds recognized good. Increase is thus orientation-sensitive feedback, not an intrinsically positive quantity.

activation_trace.role: Addition supplies the common operator whose direction context tests.
Recognition of benefit supplies the receptive orientation associated with positive increase.
Covering over a benefit supplies the anti-recognition orientation.
The focus operation repeats twice while producing explicitly adverse accumulation.
Intense abhorrence supplies the first negative output.
Commercial loss supplies the second output and reverses the nonperishing trade model.
A third contextual repetition confirms increase as an amplifier rather than a fixed reward label.
Recoiling and moving away supply the amplified trajectory in the warning scene.

structural_cues: 35:39 repeats increase in two exclusive-result clauses, each ending in a negative state.
35:42 repeats the operation again after the arrival of a warning and names increased distance as its sole result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact root repetition with positive and negative outputs; I infer a feedback rule in which prior orientation determines what gets compounded. The alternative is that the repetitions are rhetorically related but not one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Increase is a universally positive addition bestowed after good action.
changed_reading.after: Increase is a recursive amplifier: receptive recognition grows into bounty, while concealment and resistance grow into loss and distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Forgiveness later appears beside restraint while the created order is held back from removal, and the closing conditional delays seizure for what people earned until an appointed term. Forgiveness can therefore preserve the subject and its time for response, suspending collapse rather than merely deleting a completed debit.

activation_trace.role: Protection from offense's consequence supplies the focus-side suspension of liability.
Eventual completion keeps suspension from becoming an abandoned account.
Active holding supplies preservation against immediate collapse.
Removal from place or state supplies the collapse being restrained.
Deliberate restraint and self-command supply the temporal patience paired with forgiveness.
Protective covering beside cosmic holding spatializes forgiveness as preservation.
Acquiring benefit through action supplies the conduct for which seizure could occur.
Leaving something in its state supplies the threatened absence of surviving life under immediate reckoning.
Postponement to a later time supplies the mercy interval.
A fixed endpoint supplies the limit at which suspension becomes completion.

structural_cues: 35:41 ends its holding-from-removal scene with restraint and forgiveness paired together.
35:45 uses a counterfactual immediate seizure followed by explicit postponement to a fixed term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies holding, prevented removal, restraint, forgiveness, earned liability, postponement, and a fixed term; I infer that forgiveness preserves the debtor and the response interval. The alternative is that cosmic preservation and delayed human reckoning are parallel examples of power, not a gloss on 35:30.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness simply erases liabilities before an otherwise immediate final settlement.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness also holds collapse and seizure in suspension, preserving the person and the time in which growth, repair, and eventual completion remain possible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins two idiomatically distant focus branches, complete attendance and the whole company, to plural grammar. It remains anchored in the completion and covering roots plus plural recipients and rewards. Downstream prose should present it as a collective spatial activation, not as a lexical replacement for the ordinary payment reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Plural recipients and rewards can interact with branches of complete gathering and an all-inclusive company.

activation_trace.role: Complete arrival and attendance supply a gathered endpoint with nobody still en route.
The entire company without omission supplies collective scope across ranks.
Plural returns for work keep the collective image attached to actual reward.

changed_reading.before: The verse closes separate individual ledgers.
changed_reading.after: One live image is complete communal mustering: reward includes bringing the whole recipient company to the appointment without omission.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain model is surprising because it combines elevation, an unguarded roof, and protective covering from remote nominal branches. Each element is still focus-root anchored and yields a coherent spatial change. Render it only as an exploratory material analogy, never as the direct denotation of the verse's reward noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Branches under completion, reward, forgiveness, and bounty form a spatial sequence from elevation and exposure to cover and habitability.

activation_trace.role: Reaching an elevated overlook supplies upward arrival.
A roof lacking a protective boundary supplies exposure at the achieved height.
Covering that protects supplies the conversion of exposure into safety.
Free giving supplies what makes bare achievement inhabitable rather than precarious.

changed_reading.before: Reward raises status by adding an external amount.
changed_reading.after: A spatial activation raises the recipient to an exposed height, then makes that achievement safe and inhabitable through protective cover and gift.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is odd because the relapse branch under forgiveness runs against the dominant positive adjective, but it becomes coherent beside the reward root's fracture-repair branch. The focus anchoring is exact while the temporal arrow is reader-supplied. Downstream prose should describe recurrent rehabilitation as a carried possibility, not claim that the divine title means relapse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The same focus verse contains a fracture-setting branch, a wound-relapse branch, completion, and strong response to slight input.

activation_trace.role: Repair of a fracture that may heal crooked supplies imperfect rehabilitation.
A wound or illness returning after improvement supplies temporal recurrence.
Completion without deficiency remains the horizon across repeated repair.
Strong recovery from little input supplies resilience within the repeated cycle.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness and reward close a one-time account after a clean recovery.
changed_reading.after: A contained medical reading keeps restoring a subject whose wounds or distortions can recur, aiming at completeness through repeated rehabilitation.

strongest_changes: 35:1 changes increase from added possession into possible augmentation of created capacity.
The rain sequences make appreciation a generative response that turns slight input into living, differentiated yield.
35:29 changes wages into the return path of nonperishing commerce: expenditure returns intact and grows.
35:32 makes bounty prior and inclusive through inheritance while forgiveness and appreciation mediate an unequal recipient spectrum.
35:34-35 realizes bounty as permanent dwelling without grief or depletion, while 35:39 and 35:42 reveal increase as an orientation-sensitive feedback operator.
35:41 and 35:45 change forgiveness from simple erasure into preservation and delayed reckoning bounded by an appointed term.
summary.what_was_special: The six focus roots did not settle into one accounting metaphor. Their branch geometry sustained legal settlement, corrective repair, ecological amplification, journey provision, created-capacity change, and spatial shelter at once; the secondary provision mapping under the increase root and the later negative repetitions were especially productive surprises.
remaining_uncertainties: The scope of the focus plural may stay with the actors of 35:29 or may be retrospectively widened by the inherited classes of 35:32.
Created-capacity increase is strongly activated by 35:1 but may remain analogy rather than a claim about the direct object in 35:30.
The plant and animal response branches under appreciation may describe the mechanism of reward or only enrich its imagery.
The holding and delay scenes may gloss forgiveness as preservation, or they may be parallel demonstrations of power and restraint.
The provision reading depends on a legitimate packet-supplied secondary mapping but remains form-distant and should not displace ordinary addition.
